name: nxgallery-switch2
title: NXGallery
author: Jonathan Verbeek; Switch 2 port by wowilookgood
description: An unofficial Switch 2 build of NXGallery: your screenshots and videos on your phone or PC.
details:
NXGallery serves the console's album over your network, so you can open and download screenshots and videos from a phone or PC browser. This is an unofficial build of NXGallery 2.0.0 for a Switch 2 running kaiHEN, not an upstream release.

It reads captures recorded on a Switch 2, from the SD card and the internal storage.

Report Switch 2 problems in the fork's issues, not to upstream.
